description: The single asset manifest for the wdu-procedural-crystal fixture. Every runtime asset is listed here; the scene loads no network asset, so a fresh checkout installs, builds, and renders offline. The Draco decoder files are committed locally under /draco/ so DRACOLoader.setDecoderPath('/draco/') never reaches a CDN.

assets.purpose: Header brand mark, rendered in the server HTML.
Art-directed desktop poster fallback (16:9) for the procedural crystal — composed from the live scene's palette, subject, and accent light (IP-05C pattern).
Art-directed portrait poster fallback (9:16) per 3d-art-direction's separate-portrait-poster rule.

The one optimized procedural crystal asset (Draco-compressed GLB), produced by the documented inspect/validate/optimize pipeline (scripts/build-model.mjs) and committed under reports/model/. The optimization is the only transform — the geometry was generated by procedural-generation/generator.py (Blender Python, crystal-growth).
Local Draco decoder binary (three@0.185.1 examples/jsm/libs/draco/draco_decoder.wasm). DRACOLoader.setDecoderPath('/draco/') resolves to this file; no runtime CDN fetch.
Local Draco decoder wrapper. Same source as three's committed module; committed under public/draco/ so the decoder is fully offline.
Local Draco JS fallback decoder (used when WASM streaming is unavailable). Same source as three's committed module; fully offline.
